test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'COLOUR' is written as 'FQOQXT' and 'VIOLET' is written as 'YKRNHV'. How will 'PURPLE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57c85ff91bf5ee3c36993af98552fea91f4f16958e4f2f84f0c6d620d82575ee.png] 

'COLOUR' is written as 'FQOQXT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2c9501dd94c3f8823fa6b49ce7f8362dceaa1a265b3eebd596b938c2a01d5d4.png] 

And,

'VIOLET' is written as 'YKRNHV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/284d08f4f5739d3df6206db15b0ee24341f939c512bccb78847e8ba55eff1758.png] 

Similarly,

'PURPLE' be written '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63dc9b0e6f445a89affd48c87c43b1a73a4b4030ed992ee01a5e762fcc1afcfe.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"SWUROG".**
